title: 第6章 老丑记忆觉醒，杀人坏婚礼
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老丑一路施展轻功，迅捷而归，踏着清晨第一缕阳光返回。

仙宫内一切平静。老丑不敢大意。

此番下山不仅得了功法还收了一个美奴，虽寻不得仇万离，但也有意外之喜。

此刻白小楼人头在手，正好邀功，刚去汇报。却不曾想被拒在门外。不得入见苏若雪当面。

只得到守备主管转达的淡淡一句。知道了。

老丑只能作罢，心中愤恨不已。好大的架子！

回到杂役院又一番打坐。

终于在采补吸收了萧月娥纯正元阴后，混元无极功突破第一层。

老丑心中大喜，却不曾想下一刻，脑海中猛地一炸。

那些画面像碎玻璃扎进来。

大殿。金椅。年轻的手搭在扶手上，下面黑压压跪了一片美奴。

那人非是旁人，正是他自己！

“不——！““李乾坤。“他嘴唇发抖，“我是李乾坤，我才是这锁仙宫真正的主人！“此刻异界来人和原身终是融为了一体。也告原身浑浑噩噩四十年生活结束！

---今日，宫内忙碌许多，下人来来往往，张灯结彩。

“主人要成亲了，跟陈至尊成亲，宫内上下都在准备呢。““成亲？“老丑脚步顿住。

“陈逸风。“此刻他已恢复了全部神智，“陈安之子！父债子偿，就从夺走你儿子的女人开始。““老子绝不会让你们如愿成婚！“阴冷地笑着。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lao Chou performed Qing Kung along the way and returned quickly, returning with the first ray of sunshine in the morning.

All is peaceful in Asgard.Lao Chou dare not be careless.

This time when I went down the mountain, I not only got the skills but also took in a beautiful slave. Although I couldn't find revenge for Wanli, I also had unexpected joy.

At this moment, Bai Xiaolou had his head in hand, so he wanted to take credit and just went to report.But I never wanted to be shut out.You are not allowed to see Su Ruoxue in person.

He only received a faint sentence conveyed by the defense supervisor.knew.

Lao Chou could only give up, feeling filled with resentment.What a big rack!

I returned to the courtyard and meditated again.

Finally, after taking supplements and absorbing Xiao Yue'e's pure Yuanyin, Hunyuan Wuji Gong broke through the first level.

Lao Chou was overjoyed, but he never thought about the next moment when his mind suddenly exploded.

Those images penetrated like broken glass.

Main hall.Golden chair.The young man's hands were resting on the armrest, and there was a mass of slaves kneeling in the dark below.

That person was none other than himself!

"No -!" "Li Qiankun." His lips trembled, "I am Li Qiankun, and I am the real master of this locked fairy palace!" At this moment, the alien and the original body finally merged into one.He also told me that his life of forty years of confusion was over!

---Today, the palace is very busy, with servants coming and going, and lanterns and festoons being decorated.

"The master is getting married. He is getting married to Chen Zhizun. Everyone in the palace is preparing." "Getting married?" Lao Chou paused.

"Chen Yifeng." He had regained all his consciousness at this moment, "Chen An's son! The father's debt must be paid by the son, starting with the woman who took your son away." "I will never let you get married as you wish!" smiled coldly.
